Commentary.Commentary: The chase is about to begin. Liton Das and Mohammad Naim are out in the middle. Tim Southee to have the first crack with the new ball. Here we go...

Right then, the revised target for Bangladesh as per the DLS system is 148 in 16 overs (unconfirmed says the on-air commentator). The Kiwi players are back on the field, warming up and going through the fielding drills. The ground has dried well.

The rain break stole the momentum away from Bangladesh! They did a great job before the first break by picking four wickets and keeping the run rate in check somewhat. Once the play resumed, the touring team picked yet another wicket to peg back the hosts but after that, we witnessed scintillating batting from the pair of Phillips and Mitchell. Some insane hitting from them in their partnership and that pumped New Zealand's score to 173/5 in 17.5 overs. The rain returned again and no further play was possible in the first innings.

That's all from New Zealand's batting innings then. After winning a good toss, Bangladesh were happy to bowl first. The Kiwi openers though came hard at them, the Bangla Tigers also succeeded in removing both the openers inside the Powerplay overs. Post that, Bangladesh's bowling was tight and disciplined, and it was well backed by the fielders, for a change. Nasum Ahmed once again was the best bowler on show but every other bowler, barring Shoriful, went for aplenty in the end.

Update 2130 local (0830 GMT) - Nothing much coming from the ground, in terms of updates. Blackcaps though have tweeted - 'No update on start time just yet but covers are off and ground staff working to clear the ground.' Stay tuned, we will keep you informed.

Update 2106 local (0806 GMT) - The rain is pelting down now. The conditions look dull at the moment. If there is no more play in the first innings then New Zealand's total will be readjusted using the DLS method. The late surge from Mitchell and Phillips might help them get a few extra runs. Stay tuned for more updates...

Update 2051 local (0751 GMT) - The players are going off! Drizzle has picked up its intensity. Coming down heavily. One feels that there will be some loss of overs here. Not sure whether New Zealand will get to bat their full quota or not.

FOUR! That's clever! Good from Mitchell, he knew what Taskin was trying to do. Expects another yorker but it's a full toss on middle, Daryl shuffles across the stumps and scoops it over short fine leg.
That's perfect! A yorker outside off, good speed, Daryl tries his best to hit it through the line but misses.
FOUR! Up and over the keeper! Short again from Taskin, around off, Daryl tries to pull but the bounce gets big on his bat and goes off the top edge for a boundary.

FOUR! New Zealand are racing away! Shortish length ball outside off, Mitchell stays on the back foot and flat-bats it over mid off for a cracking boundary. The two umpires get together for a chat regarding the drizzle and decide to stay on.
A full toss on middle, it has been flicked over mid-wicket for a couple of runs. The 50-run stand comes up, off 23 balls.
Taskin Ahmed is back on. 3-0-35-1 are his figures so far.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Glenn packs a punch through extra cover for a brace. 16 from the over, 31 in the last two, New Zealand are on the charge!
Slower one probably, on a length outside off, Mitchell swings his bat at it but it takes the inner half and rolls through mid-wicket, only for a run this time.

FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries, exactly in the same spot. Bang, bang and bang. That position at mid-wicket is getting hammered by Mitchell. Mohammad Saifuddin misses his mark again, very full and on off, Daryl walks across the stumps and clobbers it across the line. No chance for the fielders in the deep. Mahmudullah is forced to think about his field.

FOUR! Bang! A cross-seam delivery but the length is right in the slot, Mitchell picks it up and hammers it over mid-wicket for another boundary. 150 up for the Blackcaps. Daryl wants to change his bat now.
FOUR! That's hit hard and powerfully. Short of a length ball on off, Mitchell waits for it on the back foot and pulls it disdainfully to the deep mid-wicket fence.
A cracking yorker, right in the blockhole, Phillips digs it out on the off side and crosses.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back on.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Phillips flicks it through mid-wicket for a run. 15 from the over.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Short delivery outside off, Phillips cuts it through point for a boundary.

50 for Glenn Phillips! It has been a terrific innings from him. Full on middle, Phillips flicks it through square leg. Two runs taken. His second half-century in this format to go along with a century. The crowd is loving it.
SIX! That is hammered! Full toss on middle, Phillips powers it over square leg for a biggie.
Short delivery on off, Mitchell punches it through point for a run.
Full on off, Phillips drives it through covers where the fielder tries to stop it but fumbles and concedes a single.
Full on off, Mitchell looks to go big but gets an inside edge. It goes towards square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Back of a length on off, Mitchell defends it to point.
Low full toss on middle, Phillips flicks it through square leg. The fielder misfields and the batsmen take three.
Length ball on middle, Mitchell flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length on off, Phillips drives it towards mid off for a single. The fielder goes for a direct hit at the bowler's end but misses it.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full on middle, Phillips flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.
A full toss on off, Mitchell goes hard at and lofts it behind the bowler for a couple of runs.
Wide! Quicker and down the leg side, it's left alone. In fact, it's another no ball. Free Hit stays...
Full and on middle, worked away down towards cow corner for a run. No ball called for overstepping. Free Hit coming...
Shortish and on off, Mitchell hangs back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Daryl Mitchell is the next batsman in.

OUT! An easy return catch for the bowler. Bangladesh are doing a great job by chipping away at the wickets. Floated and full ball on middle, Chapman goes hard at it and tries to smash it through covers but it skids in to take the inside part and lobs back to the bowler. Mahedi jumps and gleefully accepts the return catch.
Quicker one, flat and on middle, a low full toss, Phillips forces it down to long on for one.
Tossed up ball around off, it's lofted over covers for a run.
Skidding down the leg side, Chapman tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to covers.
Wide! Slips one down the leg side, Mark leaves it.

SAFE AGAIN! Islam angles in a full ball on middle and leg, sliding down, Chapman tries to flick but misses. It deflects off his pads to the off side and they cross. The bowler appeals but it's not given. Bangladesh take the DRS but the Ball Tracker shows that it's missing leg.
DRS time! Appeal for an lbw is not entertained. Bangladesh want to review it.
FOUR! EDGY! Short in length and outside off, Chapman hops to cut it over point but it bounces over his bat, kisses the top edge and hurries down to the third man fence.
A low full toss on middle and off, Phillips pushes it to mid off for a single.
Appeal for a catch! Is it a bump ball? The umpires get together again and take it upstairs...

NOT OUT! That has bounced! Shoriful pitches it up and outside off, Phillips goes hard at it and gets it away off the toe end of his bat. It brushes his front boot and lobs back to the bowler, who catches it and appeals. The umpire refers it upstairs but the replays find that it had bounced before clipping the boot.
The Bangladesh players are out in the middle, warming up. Time to get underway now. Shoriful Islam to complete his over...

Update 2013 local (0713 GMT) - The groundsmen are drying the outfield. Huge cheer from the crowd as the stumps are getting erected again. The signs are very promising here. Here comes the update. Play to resume in another seven minutes and we have not lost any overs.

Update 2010 local (0710 GMT) - The two umpires come out and are in conversation with the curator. The slight drizzle is still on but the covers are coming off. It seems that we will get underway sooner rather than later. Earlier, the match was going on with this slight drizzle, so maybe they have decided to keep that consistency. Stay tuned, we will keep you posted.

Update 1955 local (0655 GMT) - The two umpires get together! It's not looking promising. The rain has become increasingly heavy. CALLING FOR COVERS! The players are heading off the field. Let's hope it stops soon.
Short delivery on off, Chapman stands back and pulls it through square leg for a run.
Beaten! Slower one, short and outside off, holding its line, Chapman pushes at it early and misses.
Shoriful Islam is back on.

SIX! Phillips has sent it over the fence. He holds the key for the Kiwis. Shortish and on off, Glenn goes on the back foot and rifles it over extra cover. It's flat and rockets over the fence for a biggie.
Arm ball again, on middle, turned in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Mark Chapman is the next batsman in.

OUT! STUMPED! Mahedi shows the courage to toss this one up in the air and lands it full and outside off, Will Young dances down the track for a big shot but it skids past his bat and Liton does the rest easily. Superbly bowled by Mahedi!
Fuller ball on leg, it's helped off the pads but straight to short fine leg.
Quicker delivery outside off, Young tries to sweep but misses.
SIX! This one has gone all the way! Tossed up ball way wide outside off, plenty of width there, Young throws his bat at it and launches it over long off.
Mahedi Hasan is back on. 1-0-8-0 are his figures so far.
FOUR! A strong shot from Phillips! Flatter delivery on off, Glenn makes room and hammers it over extra cover for a boundary. Shot!
Tucked behind square leg for a run.
Quicker one, full and skidding in, Young tries to sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller and on middle, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Run out chance missed! Quicker arm ball on middle and leg, skidding in, Phillips tries to swing it on the leg side but misses. The keeper fumbles and Young shows interest in a run. He comes running down and Liton is immediate to the ball. Glenn sends his partner back as Das has a shy at the bowler's end. Misses. Young dives to make it in. What was Nasum doing? He was not at the stumps.
Tossed up ball around middle, Young makes space for an inside-out shot but ends up hitting it towards deep cover off the outer half. A single.

FOUR! Sensational drive from Phillips. Another 143.1 kph delivery, fullish and on off, Glenn hangs on the back foot and smacks it through the gap between mid off and extra cover. 10 from the over, Taskin continues to be on the expensive side. 81/3 at the halfway mark.
Beaten all ends up! A 143 kph yorker outside off, Young fails to dig it out and Liton only manages to deflect it towards fine leg. A bye is collected.
Full and on off, Phillips forces it again towards deep mid-wicket and looks for two. Only one possible this time.
Angling into the batsman around off, a fuller length ball, slower in pace, Glenn heaves it over mid-wicket for a couple.

Taskin looks for a yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss on middle, Phillips pushes it to mid off. His partner shows interest in a run but is sent back in time as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Shortish and outside off, Phillips stays back and chops it down past backward point for a couple of runs.
Taskin Ahmed is back on. 1-0-15-1 are his figures so far.
Goes back and plays it wide of the point fielder for a run. Tidy stuff from Nasum.
Eases a full ball through covers and picks up a single.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. An arm ball, landing full around off and skidding in, Young goes down and across for the sweep shot but misses. He is pinged on the front pad, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. No DRS taken. The replays show that it would have clipped the top of the stumps.
Shortish and on off, Glenn moves back and forces it through extra cover for a run.
Slower through the air, full and close to off, the batsman kneels and sweeps it towards short fine leg for one.
Floated and full on off, Phillips drives it through covers for a run.
Nasum Ahmed is back on. 2-0-13-0 are his figures so far.
Strong shot for a single. Short and outside off, cut through point for one. 8 from Mahedi's first over!

FOUR! Not quite from the middle of the bat but still enough to find the gap and the fence. Quicker and fuller, pitching on middle, Phillips tries to heave it over the leg side but it comes from the inner half and races away. Beats the long on fielder to his right and crosses the line.
Loopy and full on middle, it's flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up ball again, a touch short and on off, Young goes back and punches it through the line, finds point.
Aerial but safe! Tossed up ball landing full outside off, Glenn slices his attempted drive through covers for one.
Full and flighted on off, Young pushes it back past the bowler to long on for a run.
Mahedi Hasan is into the attack. The drizzle is falling here but not heavy enough.
Fuller length ball on middle and leg, it's quietly clipped through square leg for a run. A top over by Shoriful, 3 runs and a wicket from it.
Play and a miss! A touch short in length and outside off, leaving the batsman with angle, Young pushes inside the line and misses.
Straighter in line, Phillips works it in the gap at mid-wicket and gets off strike.
On a length around middle and off, stopping up a bit, Phillips checks his shot and defends it back.
Shortish and on leg, it's worked behind square leg for a single.
Glenn Phillips is the next batsman in.

OUT! Conway holes out! A rare failure for him. Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Devon hangs on the back foot, lifts his front leg as he tries to glance it across the line. He fails to middle his shot though and it flies off the top edge to deep square leg. A simple catch for Mohammad Mithun and Bangladesh have two wickets in as many balls. The Tigers are roaring!
Will Young is the next batsman in.

OUT! Taskin Ahmed has taken a beauty! It probably is the catch of the tour! Not a wicket-taking delivery by any means, it's full and sliding down the leg side, Guptill tries to whip it over backward square leg but it finds the inner half of his blade and flies to the left of short fine leg. Taskin Ahmed stationed there stretches out his left hand and voila, it sticks. What a catch! Bangladesh are ecstatic. 55/2 in the Powerplay for the Kiwis.
A low full toss on off, Devon bunts it down to mid on for a run.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries and Devon Conway continues his merry way. Back of a length ball around off, Conway camps back and whacks it past the diving cover-point fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Boom! There is room on offer and Conway attacks it. Full and outside off, Devon reaches out and spanks it past the falling extra cover fielder for a boundary.
The timing is not quite there for Guptill as he pushes it to extra cover for a run.
On the pads, tickled towards square leg for a single.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Conway swings his bat at it but fails to connect.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back on. 1-0-7-0 are his figures so far.
Aerial but safe! Shortish and on middle, Conway moves back and lofts it behind the bowler. They collect three runs.

This one also shoots up! The pitch is getting spicier with a slight drizzle falling down. On a length and outside off, Devon feels for it, gets beaten and Liton collects it with a jump, over his head.
Fuller length ball on off, Guptill moves across and knocks it down to long on for a run.

Oohhh...extra bounce there. It lands on off and shoots up, Conway does well to take the bottom hand off and helps it wide of point. A single is on offer and is taken. The replays show that it came off the gloves.
Shortish and close to off, Guptill taps it down to point and pinches a single.
Good length ball angling down the leg side, it's worked behind square leg for a run.
Devon Conway is the new batsman in. Also, Shoriful Islam is on.

OUT! Allen is eventually hunted down by Taskin Ahmed. He was looking to attack every ball and when you do that, you are bound to mishit one. Back of a length ball is angled into the batsman, holding up a shade after landing, Finn tries to power it across the line but gets a big top edge. It flies in the air, another tough catch but this time Naim is underneath it and the young man makes no mistake. A quickfire opening stand is broken. End of an eventful 4th over, 16 runs and a wicket from it.
Slower one, full and on off, Guptill pushes it to mid off and crosses for a run.

SIX! Dismissed! Taskin serves it in the hitting zone. Fuller and on middle and off, Guptill makes room and clobbers it straight down the ground for a biggie. This is entertaining from the Kiwi openers.
A touch short and on middle, Finn moves across to hammer it on the leg side but misses. It takes his thigh pad and rolls behind. The bowler appeals and Guptill calls his partner quickly for a run.

MAHMUDULLAH DROPS! A tough catch but needs to be taken at this level. A length ball angling in again, Finn advances down the track for a big shot across the line but skies it behind the bowler. Mahmudullah goes for it from mid off but fails to hang on. Two taken.

SIX! Boom! We have seen it all summer from Finn Allen and now he is showing it at the biggest stage. Full and on middle, Finn shuffles across and goes boom. It lands on the roof at mid-wicket. Clean as a whistle.
Taskin Ahmed is into the attack.
Wow, again! Action replay of the previous deliveries. An ordinary over is made to look like a great one now. Nasum bowled so many boundary balls but was lucky to get away with them.
This is frustrating for Guptill. Yet another short ball outside off has not been put away. Straight to the fielder.
Short again, outside off, Guptill cuts it through the line but finds the point fielder.
Shortish and close to off, Guptill mistimes his back foot punch to covers.
Short and wide outside off, Guptill fails to put it away as he finds the point fielder with his square cut.

FOUR! Up and over mid off! Full and floated around off, Guptill decides to go aerial and lifts it cleanly over the in-ring fielder for a boundary. Not an easy shot to play with the left-armer's angle.
Fuller in length and angling in, Guptill eases it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
A short ball to follow the batsman down the leg side, a reactive pull shot by Finn and it goes to deep mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Stupendous shot! Saifuddin follows the batsman down the leg side with a fuller length delivery, Finn still manages to get his shot away and drills it down the ground. Beats long on and finds the fence.
Spears in a very full ball on middle, Finn stands with an open stance as he shuffles across the stumps and forces it down to mid on.
Attempts for a yorker but it turns out to be a low full toss on the pads, Guptill bunts it down to mid on and scoots to the other end.
Good length ball close to off, Guptill stays back and plays it down to the left of backward point. A loud shout of no follows.
Mohammad Saifuddin to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! WHOA! That's some way to get your first international runs. Flighted and around middle, Allen brings out the reverse-batted shot and nails it through point. Slightly uppish but away from the fielder present there. It beats his dive and races behind.
Shortish and on off, Finn walks across the stumps and defends it on the leg side.
Arm ball, full and on middle, a similar sort of delivery that got him last time, Finn defends it back sensibly.
Quicker one, flat and short around off, Guptill plays it late and dabs it towards short third man for one.
FOUR! A good way to start for New Zealand and Guptill. Short and wide outside off, Martin latches onto it and smashes it aerially but safely through the gap at cover-point.
Arm ball to start. Flatter and on middle, Guptill pushes it back to the bowler.

Thank goodness, we are having a prompt start! It's very overcast though and Bangladesh have won a good toss here. Can they utilize the conditions to their advantage? The players are making their way out to the middle. Martin Guptill and Finn Allen are the Kiwi openers. The latter bagged a golden duck in his T20I debut and would be eager to prove a point. Nasum Ahmed to start with the ball. Here we go...

Afif Hossain is in for a quick chat! Says that he enjoyed the first T20I and shares that he's happy with his performance but he would have been happier had it come in a winning cause. Feels that they are adjusting well to the NZ conditions. Mentions that if he gets the chance, he would try to do well with the ball as well. Tells that if they play to their full potential, they can win the match.

Pitch report - It might just be holding up a bit. The surface is quite hard and it may have some moisture with all the rain around. One half of the pitch is grassy and it could be two-paced. The pitch was under cover but the good news is that it has stopped drizzling.

Ish Sodhi catches up for a quick chat! Says that it's always nice to contribute. Mentions that it's quite a spontaneous decision to bowl inside the Powerplay in the last match as usually, Santner bowls that time. Feels that the googly is very effective as you want to keep the ball away from the batsmen. States that the boundaries are very short square of the wicket so the length is usually going to be fuller.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Finn Allen, Devon Conway (WK), Will Young, Glenn Phillips, Mark Chapman, Daryl Mitchell, Tim Southee (C), Ish Sodhi, Adam Milne (In for Lockie Ferguson), Hamish Bennett.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Mohammad Naim, Liton Das (WK), Soumya Sarkar, Mohammad Mithun, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Mahedi Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Nasum Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Taskin Ahmed (In for Mustafizur Rahman).

Tim Southee, the skipper of New Zealand says that just because of the weather, it would have been better to bowl. Adds that it's still a good wicket to bat on. Informs that Adam Milne comes in for Lockie Ferguson and it is exciting to have him back. States that everyone is excited to represent the country.

Mahmudullah, the captain of Bangladesh, says that they are bowling first because of the overcast conditions and the DLS method expected to play its part. He hopes to restrict New Zealand to a decent total. Adds that they will try to be positive and aggressive at the same time. Mentions that there were a few chances in the last match but they failed to capitalize. Informs about the one change - Mustafizur Rahman is not playing, Taskin Ahmed comes in his place.

Toss time in Napier! We are still waiting for updates from the ground. Here it comes! Both Tim Southee and Mahmudullah are in the centre. The former gives it a good toss and it comes down in favour of the latter. BANGLADESH ELECT TO FIELD!

Welcome, folks! It's a must-win game for Bangladesh if they want to stay relevant in this series. Are they ready to put up a fight? The way they have performed thus far gives very little hope but you never know in this format. One moment of brilliance and things change for good. The Bangla Tigers would be praying for that magic to stop New Zealand's winning juggernaut against them. Should be an exciting contest if Bangladesh's batting comes to the party. Stay tuned for more...
